tape.name: bulb-l77-lava
tape.description: ⛓⛓⛓ seedling-fidelity-bulb — THE BULB'S DEATH WRITES LAVA. L77, the player at (88,40) north of `bulb@80,72` (built at (88,80)) with a sword, facing south. The Bulb chases (Bob's block, moveSpeed 0.65); one press kills it (`hitsMax` 1, billed t 49). `startDeath` is empty: the armed update runs alive and ends in "drop" (t 50, tile (5,3)); the body slides to the tile's centre; "drop"'s `endAnim` writes LAVA there and plays "die" (t 76); "die"'s removes it (t 103, no fade). The player then walks south onto the tile: the lava hit (t 110), the drown, `die()` (t 140) and `restartLevel()` — and the rebuilt room has the Bulb back and the tile restored, which the walk re-crosses. Authored by scripts/procgen/plan-seedling-bulb.mjs.
